description.education-and-experience-details: and today I work as Technology Director at AltPay and as a Software Engineer at B91, both in the payments market. Day to day I mostly use JavaScript/TypeScript and its ecosystem, with frameworks like NestJS, Nitro, Express, Vue, Nuxt, React and Next.js, and databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB. projects.title: My projects
projects.description: Here is the list of the projects that I'm much satisfied with the results, some of them I made to learn something new and other ones I made to get earning form it.

flaggleversus.description: Flaggle Versus is a flag guessing game I built mobile first. You can play solo in six modes (like Mosaic, Fog and Silhouette), open a room and challenge your friends in real time, compete in the daily challenge ranking or practice with spaced repetition flash cards. I built the whole thing with Nuxt and Nitro, MongoDB and Ably for the real time matches, with tests in Vitest and Playwright. The answer never reaches the browser before it should, so there's no way to cheat.

tonebook.description: Tonebook came from something I wanted for myself: getting the tones of the songs I like into my LIVTRA NanoCore pedal without spending hours turning knobs. It talks to the pedal straight from the browser through Web MIDI. You pick a song, the tone is sent right away, and you can tweak every effect while playing, name the preset and save it on the pedal. To get there I studied the MIDI guide and reverse engineered the SysEx commands the official app uses. It can also record the tab with your camera and the pedal's sound.

easyfinance.description: Easy Finance is a personal finance app for Android and the web. You set up your month in a short step by step flow (budgets, fixed costs, variable costs and goals), and the dashboard shows the expected balance, how much of each budget is already spent and the upcoming bills, with push notification reminders. You can put money into your goals and import your bank statement as OFX, reviewing the entries first and skipping anything already imported. I built the app and the API in the same Nuxt project, with MongoDB, accounts with Better Auth (email, Google and GitHub), notifications through Firebase, an admin panel and the Android app with Capacitor.

pontodigital.description: PontoDigital is an innovative platform for employee time tracking. It allows real-time monitoring of in-person, remote, and hybrid teams with detailed reports and customization. Offering API integration, data security, and dedicated support for businesses of all sizes.

rocketlaunches.description: RocketLaunches is the app for space enthusiasts! With it, you can know the upcoming rocket launches, explore information about missions, and see the latest news on space exploration. There are also options for developers who want to integrate this data into their projects.

gbreath.description: GBreath is an open-source project designed to assist meditation practitioners with breathing techniques. With it, users can enhance their breathing skills and promote well-being. It’s an accessible and user-friendly tool, perfect for those seeking relaxation or emotional control.
